source.name: Footy Headlines: CONFIRMED: Adidas Levels Up Curaçao for 2026 World Cup Last Minute
source.quote: Adidas has replaced Kelme as the kit maker for Curaçao just one week before the island nation secured their historic qualification for the 2026 World Cup

note: adidas replaced Kelme as FFK kit maker in November 2025 (the deal was announced with Dutch retailer Voetbalshop rather than as a direct adidas HQ contract, and FFK/adidas social posts said it ran 4.5 years from 10 November 2025; neither detail is in a citable text article). Value not disclosed.
